descriptive_cleanup_python:
def cleaned(text):
    text = re.sub(r"\[[^]]*\]", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"&=[^\s]+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\(([^)]*)\)", lambda m: m.group(1) if re.fullmatch("[A-Za-z]+", m.group(1)) else " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(?:xxx|yyy|www)\b", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r'\+(?:"/\.|"|[^\s]*)', " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"(?<=[A-Za-z]):+(?=[A-Za-z])", "", text)
    return " ".join(text.split())
